title: Design notes: Homage system
text: Token-driven design system (inst/tokens/albers-tokens.yml) now controls families, presets, dark calibrations. Deterministic composition blocks (.albers-composition) add signature visual motif. Semantic callout variants (callout-note, callout-insight, callout-warning, callout-experiment) available. Contrast validation now checks family/preset combinations AA thresholds.

title: Design notes: Homage system
text: Use callout-note neutral guidance. Use callout-insight interpretation design intent. Use callout-warning choice clear tradeoffs. Use callout-experiment exploratory provisional guidance.

Design notes: Homage system
code: contrast_ratio <- function(fg, bg) {   to_rgb <- function(x) as.numeric(grDevices::col2rgb(x)) / 255   to_lin <- function(u) ifelse(u <= 0.03928, u / 12.92, ((u + 0.055) / 1.055)^2.4)   luma <- function(x) {     rgb <- to_rgb(x); lin <- to_lin(rgb)     0.2126 * lin[1] + 0.7152 * lin[2] + 0.0722 * lin[3]   }   l1 <- luma(fg); l2 <- luma(bg)   if (l1 < l2) { tmp <- l1; l1 <- l2; l2 <- tmp }   (l1 + 0.05) / (l2 + 0.05) }  ratio_structural <- contrast_ratio("#C22B23", "#e6e9ed") ratio_adobe <- contrast_ratio("#C22B23", "#ece9e7") stopifnot(ratio_structural >= 4.5, ratio_adobe >= 4.5)  data.frame(   context = c("structural bg", "adobe bg"),   ratio = c(ratio_structural, ratio_adobe) ) #>         context    ratio #> 1 structural bg 4.706474 #> 2      adobe bg 4.742774

title: Design notes: Homage system
text: One family per page (A900/A700/A500/A300 → roles) Links + focus use AA tones; anchors reveal typographic dash hover Callouts tables use quiet A300 tints; code blocks use structural left ribbon

title: Design notes: Homage system
text: Families available: red, lapis, ochre, teal, green, violet. four tones: A900: links focus light mode; strongest contrast A700: highlights (one series per plot); nav active marker A500: borders, dash anchors, code ribbons, structural rules A300: tints callouts table stripe; links/focus dark mode

title: Design notes: Homage system
text: original Homage families favor single hue family per plot page. want different aesthetic (pulled grid image), use image-derived palettes scales. mirror API fully opt-. Sequential (image-based)  Diverging (image-based)  Notes - *_img scales opt-don’t change existing defaults. - neutral can set "#e5e7eb" (site border token) visual coherence pages. - Prefer original single-family scales quieter, unified look; reach image-derived diverging scales emphasize contrasts.
code: mtcars |>   ggplot(aes(wt, mpg, colour = hp)) +   geom_point(size = 2.2) +   labs(title = "Image-derived sequential (lapis)") +   albersdown::scale_color_albers_img(     "lapis",     discrete = FALSE,     breaks = c(100, 150, 200, 250, 300)   ) +   ggplot2::guides(     colour = ggplot2::guide_colorbar(       title.position = "top",       barheight = grid::unit(70, "pt"),       barwidth = grid::unit(10, "pt")     )   ) +   ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "right") df <- transform(datasets::faithful, centered = waiting - mean(waiting)) ggplot(df, aes(eruptions, centered, colour = centered)) +   geom_point(alpha = 0.9) +   labs(title = "Image-derived diverging (red <-> teal)") +   albersdown::scale_color_albers_img_red_teal(neutral = "#e5e7eb")

title: Design notes: Homage system
text: Links focus rings always meet AA. Move cursor H2/H3 reveal structural dash anchor. Style modes - style: minimal (default): lighter rules quieter dash language. - style: balanced: calibrated middle ground. - style: assertive: stronger edges emphatic structural marks.

title: Theme Showcase: Directions and Families
text: albersdown two orthogonal axes: direction sets page mood: homage (warm cream ground, Newsreader serif body, light code blocks) interaction (cool grey ground, -grotesk type, dark code blocks). family sets accent hue used links, nested-square marker, plot palettes: red, lapis, ochre, teal, green, violet. family pairs either direction. page rendered homage + red; vignette("getting-started") shows homage vignette("interaction") shows cool direction full.

title: Theme Showcase: Directions and Families
text: family four-tone ramp (A900 → A300). marker, links, plot scales draw active family.
code: albersdown::albers_swatch(c("red", "lapis", "ochre", "teal", "green", "violet")) families <- c("red", "lapis", "ochre", "teal", "green", "violet") accent_a700 <- vapply(families, function(f) albersdown::albers_palette(f)[["A700"]], character(1))  plot_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(families), function(i) {   d <- mtcars   d$family <- families[[i]]   d })) plot_df$family <- factor(plot_df$family, levels = families)  ggplot(plot_df, aes(wt, mpg, colour = family)) +   geom_point(alpha = 0.85, size = 1.7) +   facet_wrap(~family, ncol = 3) +   scale_color_manual(values = accent_a700) +   labs(     title = "The same data in each family's A700 accent",     subtitle = "Geometry held constant, only the accent family changes",     x = "weight", y = "mpg"   ) +   theme(legend.position = "none")

what: Choosing a palette family per page
title: Minimalist Theme and Vignette Kit for pkgdown and R Markdown
text: Families: red, lapis, ochre, teal, green, violet. Presets: homage, study, structural, adobe, midnight. YAML, add: params: { family: "red", preset: "study" } setup, call: ggplot2::theme_set(albersdown::theme_albers(family = params$family, preset = params$preset)) plot text feels small, increase base_size (e.g., 13–14): ggplot2::theme_set(albersdown::theme_albers(family = params$family, preset = params$preset, base_size = 14)) Add albers-header.html alongside albers.css albers.js, point includes: in_header . Add body class CSS tokens switch family: cat(sprintf('<script>document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",function(){document.body.classList.add("palette-%s");});</script>', params$family)) Add body class CSS preset styles switch preset: cat(sprintf('<script>document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",function(){document.body.classList.add("preset-%s");});</script>', params$preset))

title: One-shot setup for existing packages — use_albersdown
text: path Path package directory.  Must supplied explicitly; default function never writes unexpected location. family one : "red","lapis","ochre","teal","green","violet" preset Visual preset (default "homage"). See albers_presets(). apply_to "" patch every .Rmd/.qmd vignettes/, "new" add template assets dry_run TRUE, show changes without writing fallback_extra Controls writing site-wide fallbacks pkgdown/: "auto": write pkgdown/extra.css pkgdown/extra.js whenever site-wide defaults needed, including standard template: { package: albersdown } setup pkgdown template assets copied linked automatically. "always": always write pkgdown/ (useful safety net custom setups). "never": never copy site-wide fallbacks. force_replace TRUE (default), overwrite existing albersdown assets replace existing vignette CSS/header hooks albersdown becomes active theme.

title: albersdown 2.0.0
text: albersdown 2.0.0 visual redesign organised around two curated directions — homage (warm cream ground, Newsreader serif body, light code blocks) interaction (cool grey ground, -grotesk type, dark code blocks) — pairing six accent families. Pages plots now share grounds bundled typefaces, signature heading marker nested “Homage Square”.

title: albersdown 2.0.0
text: featured visual directions now homage interaction: albers_presets() returns c("homage", "interaction"). homage preset redefined gallery white warm cream ground. legacy presets study, structural, adobe, midnight still accepted theme_albers(), gt_albers(), albers_bs_theme() backward compatibility, longer featured. Typography moved system-font stack (Avenir Next, etc.) bundled web fonts: Familjen Grotesk + Newsreader (homage) Space Grotesk + Hanken Grotesk (interaction), Spline Sans Mono / JetBrains Mono code. fonts ship inst/fonts/ SIL Open Font License. em-dash heading marker replaced nested-square marker whose inner squares follow active family whose outer ring direction’s signature hue. theme_albers() theme_albers_void(): base_family now defaults NULL. unset, theme uses direction’s display font registered albers_register_fonts(), otherwise system "sans" family.

title: albersdown 2.0.0
text: albers_register_fonts(): register bundled display fonts (Familjen Grotesk, Space Grotesk) R graphics plot text matches HTML typography. Requires systemfonts font-aware device ragg; falls back silently system fonts otherwise. interaction direction renders code blocks dark ground light syntax tokens; homage keeps light code. Inline code stays light chip directions. style intensity (minimal / balanced / assertive) now visibly scales nested-square marker structural rule weights. interactive Theme Lab now works pkgdown site, live family / direction / style / width controls, coloured palette chips, composition preview.

title: albersdown 2.0.0
text: rmarkdown::html_vignette output now lays correctly CRAN: reading column constrained drawn Albers surface card, sticky sidebar table contents wide viewports (collapsing styled card narrow screens). previous rules matched pkgdown DOM, CRAN-hosted vignettes rendered full-bleed contents stacked top. Non-default directions longer appear switch background colour partway page: active ground mirrored onto <html>, short body never reveals default ground. pkgdown site now loads full albers.js, Theme Lab interactive behaviours work rendered articles (previously standalone vignette ). ggplot2 plots now sit ground page — warm cream homage, cool grey interaction.

title: albersdown 2.0.0
text: use_albersdown() migrate_albersdown() default preset = "homage", copy bundled web fonts vignettes/fonts/, inject albers_register_fonts() ragg device vignette setup chunks, add fonts resource_files. generated pkgdown/extra.js now carries full albers.js consumer sites get complete behaviour. gt_albers() albers_bs_theme() use per-direction type pairings. Setup writes html_vignette metadata form rmarkdown honours, single idempotent runtime class hook; re-running longer duplicates marked README note vignette class-injection block.

title: albersdown 2.0.0
text: New Interaction vignette demonstrating cool direction end end. Theme Showcase reworked directions × families gallery: palette swatches, per-family plots, side--side warm/cool example plots. two proof vignettes now render real non-default combinations (Homage + teal, Interaction + ochre).

title: albersdown 1.0.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-04-01 Initial CRAN release. theme_albers() theme_albers_void(): minimalist ggplot2 themes configurable palette presets typographic defaults. Colour scales continuous, diverging, discrete, highlight palettes (scale_color_albers(), scale_fill_albers_diverging(), scale_color_albers_distinct(), scale_color_albers_highlight(), image-derived variants). albers_palette(), albers_ramp(), albers_swatch() working built-colour system. gt_albers(): apply Albers styling gt tables. albers_bs_theme(): bslib Bootstrap 5 theme pkgdown sites. use_albersdown() use_albers_vignettes(): one-command setup helpers adopt Albers theming across entire R package. migrate_albersdown(): migrate assets older albersdown layout. Two vignettes: “Getting Started” “Design Notes”.
